items.title: KC Concepcion: Finds end zone in preseason debut
items.description:
Concepcion caught three of four targets for 27 yards and took his only carry 14 yards for a touchdown in Saturday's 34-10 preseason loss to the Bears.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Looks sharp in preseason opener
items.description:

items.title: Ray Davis: Seven touches in preseason opener
items.description:
